name: North American P-51D Mustang
summary: The long-range escort fighter of the Second World War: a laminar-flow wing, a belly radiator and a Packard-built Merlin, with the bubble canopy of the D model. Over 8,000 P-51Ds were built.

takeoff.note: Approximate: clean, mid weight, tail raised on the roll

verify.note: Standing on its tail wheel with one propeller blade straight up, the FlightGear model reaches 4.36 m against the published 4.08 m; the fin top stands at 2.98 m, and the propeller is the right 3.4 m across, so the difference is in the ground attitude.
